## About
McKinney Spine & Wellness is a chiropractic office on W Virginia St in McKinney, led by Dr. Shane Cowan. Dr. Cowan is a strong believer in comprehensive multidisciplinary care and has firm relationships with medical doctors, pain management specialists, behavioral health specialists and orthopedic surgeons.
Care here goes beyond the adjustment. The office offers spinal decompression, massage therapy, electric muscle stimulation, cold laser and shockwave therapy, ultrasound, therapeutic exercises and in-house X-rays, all built into treatment plans that are easy to understand and follow.
Whether you were hurt in a car accident, injured on the job, or just want to move without pain, the team will walk you through your options. Citlally and Kendal were thanked by name in reviews for their help along the way.

## Services
- Adjustments: Dr. Cowan uses a variety of adjustment techniques, including Diversified, Thompson Drop, Activator and Myofascial Release, plus some Gunstead and SOT.
- Automobile accident care: If you were hurt in an automobile accident, call to make an appointment and the office can help guide you through your claim.
- Workers compensation: Injured on the job? Dr. Cowan is very knowledgeable with workers compensation and can help guide you in the right direction with your claim.
- Massage: The practice includes two massage therapists whose work complements the chiropractic care.
- Exams and X-rays: A first visit can include a consultation, exam, X-rays, EMS therapy and an adjustment.
- Cold laser therapy: One of the therapies offered alongside adjustments to support your treatment plan.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with insurance?
A: Yes. The office works with most insurance plans, including Medicare, as well as auto insurance, workers compensation, attorneys and cash plans.

Q: Do you see children?
A: Yes. Dr. Cowan treats all ages, as young as newborns. Expectant mothers are also welcome.

Q: Can I fill out forms before my first visit?
A: Yes. New patient paperwork is on the website. Fill out the forms and bring them with you to your appointment.

Q: Are you open over lunch?
A: The office closes for lunch on Mondays and Wednesdays and for business meetings midday on Thursdays. It is closed on weekends.
